record.question: How to drill a hole the epigenetic mineralization, which is associated with normal fault, to predict the likely attitude of high grade ore shoots within or adjacent to it after initial discovery of ore?
options: By drilling a hole to along strike from the discovery hole to intersect the target at the same depth.
By drilling a hole to the same depth as the discovery hole and along strike from it.
By drilling a deeper hole on the same cross-section.
By drilling a hole along the dip direction from the discovery hole.
